recomputed.verifier_value: Each edge launches a ring at f_r with amplitude equal to the commutated current (31.3 A at turn-off, ~23 A valley current at turn-on). With R_loop 6-20 mOhm: Q = 6-21, tau = 3-10 us, ring RMS 7.5-13.7 A total = 0.75-1.4 A per MLCC (6-10x the agent's 0.13 A). Film share of the ring loss (3.75 mOhm of ~8-10 mOhm) ~0.4-0.5 W -> +0.2-0.25 W per film part, +2.5-3 K hotspot
recomputed.note: Thermally tolerable for the MLCCs (tens of mW each) but must be stated; the proposed 0.47 Ohm damping resistor would absorb most of this ~1 W and needs a >= 2 W rating, not a small SMD.

KR-CAP-003 is applied as 'direct' although the knowledge base records the purpose of TI's MLCC columns as 'inferred' (TI does not state it); applicability should be marked 'adapted' with the inference noted, as SKILL-003 itself does.

Assumption A7 (about 1 A/ns, about 20 V overshoot at 20 nH) was set inside the capacitor area although the design basis assigns the edge rate to the MOSFET/gate-driver areas, whose results (2.5 A/ns design di/dt, 25/35 nH, 62/88 V overshoot, 6.4 A/ns fault turn-off) were available; the overshoot calculation therefore understates the sibling values by 3-4x.

IEC 62477-1 'clause 4.4.9' is cited as a basis without the standards agent's caveat that 62477-1 clause numbers are secondary-source/unverified and that 4.4.9 is the 2023-edition renumbering of 61800-5-1 4.3.11.

No copying of reference instance values was found; SKILL-003 exclusions (DC-blocking, lifetime modelling) and the human-review rules (KR-ISO-002, PE-PCB-002/003/006, SKILL-006 step 3, SKILL-005 interface) were surfaced rather than decided.
required_changes: Add the film-to-ceramic resonance ring to the HF-tier and film analyses: energy 0.5 L_int (I_off^2 + I_on^2) per period = 22.6 uJ at 30 nH -> about 1.1 W dissipated in the loop resistance (0.75 W at 20 nH, 1.5 W at 40 nH); ring RMS 7.5-13.7 A total (0.75-1.4 A per MLCC for Q = 6-21) replacing the 0.13 A per-piece figure; add about 0.2-0.25 W per film part (+2.5-3 K) to the self-heating table; state the MLCC ESR at f_r and resulting MLCC heating (tens of mW each).

If the optional damping leg is kept, specify the resistor power rating from the ring energy (about 1 W average -> >= 2 W rated resistor or two 1 W 2512 in parallel) rather than an unrated '0.47 Ohm'; keep the open issue to confirm with the extracted L_int.
